answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a basalt as the anchor of the cost.
